ideas.pitch: An AI-powered satellite imagery monitoring tool tracking unauthorized structural changes and land encroachment around the IEM Gurukul building area.
ideas.title: IEM-Campus GeoSat Compliance Monitor
ideas.why_it_could_win: It leverages hard geospatial engineering and computer vision similar to previous regional winners, appealing strongly to technical judges looking for complex spatial data processing done within an 8-hour window.

ideas.pitch: An AI-driven multi-agent student support and curriculum navigation platform combining LangGraph and localized RAG specifically tailored for engineering course syllabi.
ideas.title: Academic Multi-Agent Support RAG
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets student and institutional pain points, utilizing proven multi-agent orchestration frameworks that score well in rapid hackathons.

ideas.pitch: A statistical forecasting dashboard utilizing Poisson regression and rolling backtests to predict local power grid failures and network downtime risks.
ideas.title: AI Incident Forecasting Engine for Local Infrastructure
ideas.why_it_could_win: Employs rigorous statistical modeling rather than generic LLM wrappers, matching the technical depth seen in winning forecasting entries.

ideas.pitch: An automated AI patient trust and acquisition platform tailored for local student health camps and university medical clinics, featuring instant multilingual triage.
ideas.title: ClinicTrust Patient Acquisition Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines practical utility with an immediate local deployment angle, solving a tangible real-world intake problem within a constrained 8-hour limit.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered nutrition assistant that analyzes local hostel and campus canteen menus to deliver personalized meal plans and real-time macro tracking.
ideas.title: Campus Canteen AI Nutritionist
ideas.why_it_could_win: Relates directly to everyday student life at IEM Gurukul, making the demo extremely relatable and practical for the judging panel.
